newsitem.title: USA: United Artists retains Merrill Lynch in review.
newsitem.headline: United Artists retains Merrill Lynch in review.

text.p: United Artists Theatre Circuit Inc said on Monday it has retained Merrill Lynch & Co to assist it in investigating strategic alternatives with respect to its ownership and capital structure, including a possible stock offering.

Alternatives which are being investigated include the possible sale of the privately held stock of the parent company of the United Artists Theatre Group, OSCAR I Corp, in a private or public transaction, United Artists said.
The offering would be in conjunction with the refinancing of the company's public bonds and bank debt, it said in a statement.
United Artists said it is speeding up its plans for revamping its capital structure because of, "improved operating performance of the company combined with the very favorable financial markets."
But any proposed deal is unlikely to have any effect on the company's daily operations or its development plans, United Artists said.
Any capital structure options will be evaluated for their ability to provide the Group with the financial flexibility to pursue additional future development, the company said.
United Artists is a leading operator of motion picture theatres with 2,289 screens in 369 locations, it said.
